name: Bauernhof Klampererhof
beschreibung: The farm Bauernhof Klampererhof is situated in the municipality of Bad Häring in the Tyrolean Unterland. This working farm offers cozy accommodations in holiday apartments and guest rooms. Its setting close to the Bad Häring thermal spa ensures a wonderfully relaxing stay. Guests enjoy scenic vistas across the Inn Valley and the surrounding alpine peaks. Equipped with modern amenities, the lodgings provide a welcoming retreat. Delicious regional products of the farm's own making are readily available. Excursions into the Kaiser Mountains or to the town of Kufstein are within easy reach, making it perfect for families and couples seeking tranquility.
